entry_01.prompt: Photoreal live-action at a Tang dynasty night market. A continuous locked tripod shot. The people continue their movement already underway. The women in pink and green take a step and turn with real weight, sleeves and fabric swaying as they arrive in the ending pose. People in the middle and the shoppers at the right shift and turn naturally. The awning and lantern tassels move in the breeze. Same warm night exposure. No cuts, dissolve, magic, titles or music.
